learning_outcomes.text: Rapid determination of the behavior of a controlled process and designing a control system, gaining the ability to use software packages directly related to the subject, encouraging teamwork, and computer usage.

syllabus_topics: Solving Linear Differential Equations with Laplace Transforms
Mathematical Models of Mechanical and Electrical Systems
Mathematical Model of Fluid and Thermal Systems
Mathematical Model of Fluid and Thermal Systems
Analysis and Design of Control Systems Using the Frequency-Response Method
PID Controllers and Modified PID Controllers
Analysis of Control Systems in State-Space
Analysis of Control Systems in State-Space
Selected Topics on Control Engineering Problems
